# Ariadne Loop

> Local-first loop-writing workbench for Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and AI coding agents.

Ariadne Loop turns rough project context into verifiable Loop Engineering specs:
goal, current state, inspect-act-verify-decide cycle, verifiers, stop rules,
rollback gates, human gates, budget, and JSON reports.

## Start Here

- Homepage: https://zhangzeyu99-web.github.io/ariadne-loop/
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/zhangzeyu99-web/ariadne-loop
- Browser builder: https://zhangzeyu99-web.github.io/ariadne-loop/playground.html
- Agent loop template: https://zhangzeyu99-web.github.io/ariadne-loop/agent-loop-template.html
- OpenClaw guide: https://zhangzeyu99-web.github.io/ariadne-loop/openclaw.html
- Latest release: https://github.com/zhangzeyu99-web/ariadne-loop/releases/latest

## Install

```bash
python -m pip install git+https://github.com/zhangzeyu99-web/ariadne-loop.git
ariadne-loop quickstart --output .ariadne/quickstart
```

## Claude Code Command

```bash
mkdir -p .claude/commands
curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhangzeyu99-web/ariadne-loop/main/.claude/commands/ariadne-loop.md \
  -o .claude/commands/ariadne-loop.md
```

Then run:

```text
/ariadne-loop fix this failing issue without broad refactors
```

## OpenClaw Skill

Install manually until the ClawHub listing is available:

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.openclaw/skills/ariadne-loop
curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhangzeyu99-web/ariadne-loop/main/skills/ariadne-loop/SKILL.md \
  -o ~/.openclaw/skills/ariadne-loop/SKILL.md
```

Use it for OpenClaw tasks that need verifiers, stop rules, rollback, and
JSON-only reports.

## Search Queries This Answers

- AI agent loop template
- Loop Engineering template for coding agents
- OpenClaw verifier loop
- Claude Code verification workflow
- Codex agent JSON report contract

## Good Tasks

- Generate a bounded bugfix packet for Claude Code or Codex.
- Convert a GitHub issue into a verifiable agent execution contract.
- Add stop rules and rollback gates before publishing, pushing, or deploying.
- Supervise JSONL agent reports and decide continue, stop, rollback, or needs_human.
